panels.title: Service Availability (1=Up 0=Down)
panels.description: Service availability over time for all monitored HTTP endpoints. 1 = reachable, 0 = unreachable. SOURCE: VictoriaMetrics metric 'probe_success', label job=blackbox_http, site=norrsken-kigali. Generated by Prometheus Blackbox Exporter (Docker container, port 9115) scraping HTTP/HTTPS targets every 30 seconds. Prometheus scrape config: job_name=blackbox_http, metrics_path=/probe, module=http_2xx. Scraped by Prometheus and remote_written to VictoriaMetrics. Targets: zoom.us, teams.microsoft.com, meet.google.com, web.whatsapp.com, slack.com, drive.google.com, mail.google.com, github.com, www.google.com. IMPORTANT: This measures reachability of web/signaling endpoints only — not media server reachability. A probe_success=1 for zoom.us does not confirm that Zoom calls will work well.

panels.title: HTTP Response Time (seconds)
panels.description: Total HTTP probe duration per service endpoint in seconds. SOURCE: VictoriaMetrics metric 'probe_duration_seconds', label job=blackbox_http, site=norrsken-kigali. Generated by Prometheus Blackbox Exporter every 30 seconds. Includes: DNS resolution + TCP connect + TLS handshake + HTTP request + response time combined. High values indicate slow path to that service from Kigali. Thresholds: Green <1s, Yellow 1-3s, Red >3s. Useful for detecting when specific services become slow even when they remain technically reachable (probe_success=1).

panels.title: TLS Handshake Time (seconds)
panels.description: TLS handshake duration per service endpoint in seconds. SOURCE: VictoriaMetrics metric 'probe_http_duration_seconds', label phase=tls, job=blackbox_http, site=norrsken-kigali. Generated by Prometheus Blackbox Exporter every 30 seconds. Measures time to complete the TLS 1.3 handshake with each service. TLS handshake time reflects: network RTT to service + server processing time for certificate exchange. Spikes in this panel indicate either network path degradation or server-side issues at the target service. Thresholds: Green <500ms, Yellow 500ms-1s, Red >1s.

panels.title: ICMP Latency to DNS Resolvers (seconds)
panels.description: ICMP round-trip latency to three DNS resolvers in seconds. SOURCE: VictoriaMetrics metric 'probe_duration_seconds', label job=blackbox_icmp, site=norrsken-kigali. Generated by Prometheus Blackbox Exporter every 30 seconds sending ICMP echo requests (ping) to each target. Targets and their purpose: 8.8.8.8 = Google Public DNS (measures path to Google infrastructure). 1.1.1.1 = Cloudflare DNS (measures path to Cloudflare infrastructure). 208.67.222.222 = OpenDNS (measures alternative routing path). Differences between targets indicate asymmetric routing from Kigali. Consistent latency here with degraded HTTP response times indicates the problem is server-side, not network path.

panels.title: Current Service Status
panels.description: Current UP/DOWN status per monitored service. SOURCE: VictoriaMetrics metric 'probe_success', last value, label job=blackbox_http, site=norrsken-kigali. Generated by Prometheus Blackbox Exporter every 30 seconds. Green background = service reachable (HTTP 200/301/302/403 received). Red background = service unreachable (timeout, connection refused, or unexpected HTTP status code). This panel refreshes every minute. A service showing red here indicates a potential outage or connectivity issue to that platform from the Norrsken network at this moment.
